note: claim_shape is INVISIBLE to a crate-scoped run, and a seed loop added to any crate reddens the gate from cli/. cli/tests/claim_shape.rs is a default-deny workspace lint: every test whose body loops over seeds must carry a doc-comment line claim: <shape>(...) with one of reachability/rate/invariant/behavior/readout/structural/sanctioned-sweep. It scans the WHOLE repo but LIVES IN cli/, so a -p hornvale-worldgen run is green while make gate is red. The Repose task 1 shipped a seed-looping test with no tag and left the branch red; task 2 only found it at its own first make gate. To prove a red is pre-existing rather than yours: git stash push -u -m check, then cargo test -p hornvale --test claim_shape, then git stash pop. That took 0.22 s and listed only the older test, which settled authorship immediately. Same shape as the other cli/ enforcement tests (layering, dep allowlist, heavy tier, doc drift) - a crate-scoped green is never a branch green.
